title: Lost in Translation? AI's Promise and Peril for Media in Low-Resource Languages
summary: Fondation Hirondelle reports that AI transcribes ten radio stations in Swahili and French for content monitoring in eastern DRC. Transcription quality and downstream impact remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Fondation Hirondelle reports that AI transcribes broadcasts from ten radio stations in eastern DRC in Swahili and French. Machine searches then use keywords and knowledge supplied by local journalists to flag disinformation and other problematic content. The chapter identifies current use of AI transcription, despite its broader discussion of future collaboration and language access. It says that Swahili speech recognition needs improvement and that monitoring topics need regular updates. No transcription-quality comparison, staff-time result, or downstream audience benefit is quantified.
purpose: Transcribe local radio broadcasts to support journalists’ monitoring of problematic content.
system: AI transcription for eastern DRC radio monitoring
deployer: Fondation Hirondelle and participating local journalists
location: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo

ratings.reason: The source reports that AI transcribes ten radio stations for monitoring. It does not quantify transcription quality, staff time saved, or the resulting improvement in newsroom capability.
Local audiences are intended to benefit from improved information monitoring; a change in their access to trustworthy information is not established.
Monitoring problematic content is intended to support peace and linguistic inclusion; those downstream effects are not measured.

ai_role.statement: AI converts Swahili and French broadcasts into text. Keyword searches informed by local journalists support monitoring; the chapter does not establish that those searches themselves use learned AI.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 13: Lost in Translation? AI's Promise and Peril for Media in Low-Resource Languages

produced_by: AI transcription of Swahili and French broadcasts combined with journalist-informed content monitoring
must_hold: Access to radio audio in the monitored languages
Improved Swahili speech recognition and regularly updated journalist-supplied monitoring topics
